```sql
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
wholesale_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        l.order_date,
        l.net_value * CASE WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) ELSE 1.0 END AS net_revenue_nzd,
        l.quantity * COALESCE(m.standard_cost_nzd, 0) AS total_standard_cost_nzd,
        CASE WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_cost,
        l.net_value * CASE WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) ELSE 1.0 END AS costed_revenue_nzd
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON l.material_id = m.material_id
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON l.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE l.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01'
      AND l.order_date <= DATE '2025-09-30'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN has_cost = 1 THEN net_revenue_nzd - total_standard_cost_nzd ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN has_cost = 1 THEN costed_revenue_nzd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS answer
FROM wholesale_lines
```
